summary: Fulton County lookout on Salem Knob, 55 ft with a glass house, described in a 1953 federal survey; no source found on its build, staffing or what remains today.

notes_for_editor: Height 55 ft converted to 16.8 m (the brief had no height). No source names an agency for this tower; cite 3 mentions the forestry service only in a naming theory.
